caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, wooden box-like structure with a rich brown color and lighter tan-colored edges and supporting pillars at each corner. The box features a single, centered circular knob on its front panel, suggesting a drawer. Above the main body, there is a raised back panel with six circular, eye-like decorations evenly distributed across it. Four cylindrical pillars, also tan, support a top shelf on which rests a small, rounded blue object, similar in appearance to a bowl or dome. Each corner of both the top and the main structure is adorned with a pointed, tan ornament resembling a spike or finial. The background is plain and off-white. In the lower right corner of the image, there is a small red star and the name "MAARS" written in red.
title: Bureau
